rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for calling someone’s attention or protesting and reprimanding them.
Use this for a startled reaction or, with rising intonation, when you did not hear or understand what was said.

example.english: Hey? What did you just say?
example.jyutping: haa5 nei5 tau4 sin1 gong2 mat1 aa3

rows.note: Use this stronger surprised exclamation when the reaction is closer to “wow!” than to a questioning “huh?”.

example.jyutping: waa1 hou2 daai6 gaan1 uk1 aa3

rows.note: Use this casual loanword as a friendly greeting rather than to call someone to attention.

example.english: Hey, how have you been lately?
example.jyutping: haai1 nei5 zeoi3 gan6 dim2 aa3
